Christopher ist DevOps- und Platform-Engineer bei der DATEV eG in Nürnberg. Dort betreut er im Team eine Messaging-Plattform mit Apache Kafka und RabbitMQ auf Kubernetes und virtuellen Maschinen. Zu seinen Schwerpunkten gehören Automatisierung, Cloud Foundry Service Broker, GitOps, Kubernetes sowie plattformbezogene Security- und Monitoring-Themen. 

Zusätzlich beschäftigt er sich intensiv mit KI-Themen (unter anderem Agentic Development, Model Context Protocol und einem internen Wissenshub für KI-Agenten) und verfügt über praktische Erfahrungen in Sprachen wie Java, Go, Python und Terraform. Seine Ausbildung absolvierte er als Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung (IHK) bei der DATEV, nachdem er zuvor eine Ausbildung zum Technischen Assistenten für Informatik sowie zum Kfz-Mechatroniker abgeschlossen hatte.

Christopher works as a DevOps/Platform Engineer at DATEV eG, a software company in Nürnberg, Germany. He has been in this role since July 2022, operating within a team for messaging and streaming. His work includes managing Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ platforms, developing automation and self-service tools, and working on AI initiatives such as agentic development and an internal knowledge hub.
Christopher's team runs Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ as a managed service on Kubernetes and virtual machines for more than 100 development teams per stage.
Christopher works with 6 Kafka clusters. They run on-premises in two private data centers across three stages: Development (Dev), Quality Assurance (QS), and Production (Prod).
The platform Christopher works on has a service level agreement (SLA) of 99.99%.
Yes, Christopher is comfortable with on-call duty. He is part of the on-call duty (Pikett) rotation for the Kafka platform at DATEV. The platform runs stably, and call-outs are rare.

* **Terraform**
* **Crossplane**
* **Ansible**
* **GitOps** tools (specifically **Flux CD**)
* **Helm** and **Kustomize** (for Kubernetes)

Christopher's formal education consists of:

- **09/2019 to 07/2022:** *Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung (IHK)* – a dual apprenticeship at DATEV eG, Nürnberg, with vocational school at the Martin-Segitz-Schule Fürth. He passed with a final result of "gut" (85 of 100 points) and a vocational school final grade of 1.5.
- **09/2017 to 07/2019:** *Staatlich geprüfter Technischer Assistent für Informatik* at the Heinrich-Thein-Schule, Haßfurt. He finished with a final grade of 1.33 and received the Prize of the Freundeskreis for the best performance at the Berufsfachschule.
- **09/2012 to 02/2016:** *Kfz-Mechatroniker* (Focus on Passenger Car Technology) at Autozentrale Robert Kehm KG, Bad Neustadt a. d. Saale, with a vocational school final grade of 1.75 and a *mittlerer Schulabschluss*.

Additionally, he holds a course completion certificate from the Cisco Networking Academy (CCNA Routing and Switching, Introduction to Networks, 07/2018) and online course certificates from Anthropic's Claude Academy (issued 11/2026). All of his qualifications are at level 4 of the German and European qualification frameworks (DQR/EQR), and he does not have a university degree (*Studium*).
Christopher's English proficiency is at level B2.

Yes, Christopher has worked with both MCP (Model Context Protocol) and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). 

At DATEV, he co-leads a team-internal project called the Shared Knowledge Hub (RAG) for AI Agents (MCP), which has been active since July 2026. This is a real, production-used project—it is currently used across 10 projects (with a rollout to about 30 planned) and acts as a shared context store for AI coding agents using a hybrid search (keyword search combined with semantic search over embeddings merged by rank fusion) via the Model Context Protocol.

In addition to this practical work at DATEV, he has completed formal training on the topic, holding certificates from Anthropic's Claude Academy issued in November 2026, including *"Claude Academy: Introduction to Model Context Protocol"* and *"Claude Academy: Model Context Protocol: Advanced topics."*
